blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rank - constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high - order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype - rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit arises from training time regularization, whereas inference fusion is small and dataset dependent.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tensor-valued observations arise naturally in remote sensing and in other high-dimensional problems, in which the ordering of input modes carries information. A conventional dense neural layer can ignore that structure and may introduce many parameters relative to the number of labeled observations. Rank-constrained feedforward neural networks Makantasis et al. [2018] , Makantasis et al. [2019] address this issue by representing the input-to-hidden weight tensors through a Canonical/Polyadic (CP) decomposition rather than learning unrestricted dense tensors Makantasis et al. [2021] , Kolda and Bader [2009] . The resulting Rank-R formulation retains multilinear structure while substantially reducing the number of free parameters, an attractive property for small-sample high-order learning Makantasis et al. [2021] . Rank-R representations have also been reused as embeddings for graph-based semi-supervised hyperspectral classification Georgoulas et al. [2023] .
blocks.zh: 在遥感和其他高维度问题中自然产生十进制值的观测,其中输入模式的顺序带有信息. 常规的密集神经层可以忽略这种结构,并可能针对标签观测的数量引入许多参数. Makantasis et al. [2018], Makantasis et al. [2019] 通过Canonical/Polyadic(CP)分解法代表输入到隐藏的重量计,而不是学习不受限制的密集计数器 Makantasis et al. [2021], Kolda and Bader [2009]. 由此形成的Rank-R配体保留了多线性结构,同时大幅减少了自由参数的数量,这是小样高序学习马坎塔西斯等人[2021]的吸引力属性. 军衔 R表示器也被重新用作基于图表的半监督超光谱分类Georgoulas等人的嵌入器[2023].

blocks.en: Nevertheless, parameter efficiency constrains how the mapping is represented, rather than how classes should be arranged in the learned latent space. A complementary line of research incorporates prior relations or logical constraints into differentiable learning objectives Roychowdhury et al. [2021] , Badreddine et al. [2022] , Hitzler et al. [2022] , Li et al. [2023] . Prototype-based methods provide a particularly simple class-level structure: examples of a class are related to a representative point in embedding space, and membership can be expressed through relative compatibility with class prototypes Snell et al. [2017] , Ding et al. [2024] . This suggests a natural question for Rank-R learning: can an explicit prototype relation provide information that is complementary to the low-rank tensor constraint?
blocks.zh: 然而,参数效率制约着制图的体现方式,而不是限制如何在已学到的潜在空间中安排课程。 一种互补的研究线将先前的关系或逻辑制约纳入不同的学习目标Roychowdhury等人[2021],Badreddine等人[2022],Hitzler等人[2022],Li等人[2023]. 基于原型的方法提供了一个特别简单的类层次结构:一个类的例子与嵌入空间中的代表性点有关,成员可以通过与类原型Snell等人[2017],Ding等人[2024]的相对兼容性来表示. 这对Rank-R学习来说是一个自然的问题:一个明确的原型关系能否提供补充低等级的拉伸约束的信息?

blocks.en: The present work answers that question as a controlled characterization, rather than as a state-of-the-art hyperspectral-classification benchmark. We introduce a differentiable prototype-rule regularizer into a Rank-R neural model and deliberately separate two possible mechanisms: representation shaping during training and the use of prototype evidence at inference. We further distinguish conventional stratified evaluation from spatially separated evaluation because patch-based hyperspectral experiments can be optimistic when neighboring samples from the same scene are allowed to cross split boundaries Feng et al. [2023] , Cao et al. [2023] .
blocks.zh: 目前的工作是将这个问题作为一个可控特性,而不是一个最新超光谱分类基准来回答。 我们在Rank-R神经模型中引入了一种不同的原型规则常态器,并刻意将两种可能的机理分开:在训练中塑造表现和在推断时使用原型证据. 我们进一步将常规分层评价与空间分离评价区分开来,因为如果允许来自同一场景的相邻样本跨越分界的冯等人[2023],曹等人[2023],基于补丁的超光谱实验可以乐观.

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate the mechanism under explicit per-class label budgets to test the common intuition that stronger inductive biases should become more useful as supervision decreases. This hypothesis is consistent with prior work in constraint-based prior-knowledge regularization and prototype-based few-shot learning, where additional structural information is introduced specifically to improve learning when direct supervision is limited Roychowdhury et al. [2021] , Snell et al. [2017] .
blocks.zh: 最后,我们评价每个类别明确标签预算下的机制,以检验一种共同的直觉,即随着监督的减少,更强烈的诱导性偏见应变得更加有用。 这个假说与以前在基于约束的事先知识规范化和基于原型的数发学习中的工作是一致的,在直接监管有限时引入了额外的结构信息来改进学习[2021],Snell等人[2017].

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, prior Rank-R FNN studies have not investigated explicit differentiable class rules as an additional training constraint. The novelty claim is therefore intentionally narrow: we study prototype-rule neurosymbolic regularization of CP-constrained Rank-R representations and characterize when its contribution is positive, neutral, or adverse.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,先前的Rank-R FNN研究没有将明确的不同班级规则作为另一个培训制约因素进行调查。 因此,这个新颖的说法是有意的狭隘的:我们研究CP-约束Rank-R的表达方式的原型规则神经系统规范化,并描述其贡献是积极、中立或不利的。

blocks.en: 1.1 Contributions and research questions
blocks.zh: 1.1 贡献和研究问题

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions. First, it integrates a differentiable prototype-rule mechanism into a CP-constrained Rank-R neural representation. Second, it introduces a matched ablation that isolates training-time prototype regularization from inference - time prototype fusion without changing the Rank-R backbone. Third, it evaluates the same mechanism under both spatially leakage-controlled and conventional stratified protocols and keeps their evidence separate. Fourth, it performs a dedicated spatial label-scarcity study over seven per-class budgets and five support realizations, allowing the dependence of the neurosymbolic effect on supervision, dataset, and Rank-R configuration to be examined directly.
blocks.zh: 该文件提出了四项意见。 首先,它将一种不同的原型规则机制整合到CP-约束的Rank-R神经代表. 第二,它引入了一种匹配的减法,将培训时间原型正规化与推论区分开来——时间原型聚变,而不改变Rank主干线. 第三,它评价空间泄漏控制和常规分层协议下的同一机制,并将其证据分开。 第四,在每类预算7项和5项支持实现的基础上进行专门的空间标签-恐惧性研究,从而可以直接检查神经系统对监督、数据集和Rank-R配置的依赖性。

blocks.en: These contributions are organized around five research questions. The first concerns whether the mechanism works at all: does differentiable prototype - rule regularization change classification performance relative to the corresponding purely neural Rank-R baseline (RQ1)? Where an effect occurs, we ask how much of it is attributable to training - time regularization and how much to prototype-based inference fusion (RQ2), and how the observed effect differs between conventional stratified evaluation and spatially leakage - controlled evaluation (RQ3). We further ask whether the contribution of the prototype-rule mechanism systematically increases as the number of labeled samples per class decreases (RQ4), and to what extent the effect is conditioned by dataset and Rank-R architecture (RQ5).
blocks.zh: 这些贡献是围绕五个研究问题组织的。 第一个问题是机制是否发挥作用:不同的原型——规则规范化相对于相应的纯神经Rank-R基线(RQ1)改变分类性能吗? 发生效应时,我们询问其中有多少是培训造成的----时间规范化,以及基于原型的推论组合(RQ2)的多少,观察到的影响在常规分层评价和空间渗漏----控制评价(RQ3)之间有何区别。 我们还询问,原型规则机制的贡献是否随着每类标注样品数量(RQ4)的减少而系统增加,其影响在多大程度上受到数据集和Rank-R架构(RQ5)的制约。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The proposed framework draws on two lines of work that have largely been developed separately. Rank-constrained tensor networks address the parameterization of high-order inputs but leave the geometry of the learned representation unconstrained, while neurosymbolic and prototype-based methods impose explicit class-level structure without regard on how the underlying representation is parameterized. Section 2.1 reviews the former, Section 2.2 the latter, and Section 2.3 positions the present work as a deliberately minimal combination of the two.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架借鉴了两条基本上分开制定的工作线。 排名限制的拉伸网络处理高序输入的参数化问题,但使所学表现的几何学不受限制,而神经连锁法和原型法则在不考虑基本表现如何参数化的情况下,强制规定了明确的类层次结构. 第2.1节审查前者,第2.2节审查后者,第2.3节将目前的工作作为两者的最小组合。

blocks.en: 2.1 Rank-R tensor neural networks
blocks.zh: 2.1 军衔 - R 伸缩神经网络

blocks.en: The Rank-R FNN constrains each input-to-hidden weight tensor through a CP decomposition, preserving the high-order organization of the input while replacing a full tensor by a sum of rank-one factors Makantasis et al. [2021] , Kolda and Bader [2009] . This parameterization is especially relevant when the input dimensionality is high but labeled data are limited. Subsequent work has reused Rank-R-derived tensor embeddings in graph-based semi-supervised hyperspectral classification, showing that the representation can support additional relational structure beyond the original classifier Georgoulas et al. [2023] . The present work differs from these studies by changing the learning objective itself through an explicit class-level constraint.
blocks.zh: Rank-R FNN通过CP分解来约束每个输入到隐藏的重量计数器,保留输入的高顺序组织,同时用一级因素Makantasis et al. [2021],Kolda和Bader[2009]的总和取代一个完整的计数器. 这种参数化在输入维度高但标签数据有限时特别相关. 之后的工作将Rank-R衍生的拉诺嵌入到基于图的半监督超光谱分类中,表明该表示能够支持超出原分类器Georgoulas等人[2023]的额外关系结构. 目前的工作与这些研究不同,通过明确的班级限制来改变学习目标本身.

blocks.en: 2.2 Neurosymbolic and prototype-based learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 神经元和原型学习

blocks.en: Neurosymbolic learning broadly combines neural representation learning with symbolic, logical, or knowledge-based structure Hitzler et al. [2022] , Wang et al. [2025] . Differentiable approaches such as Logic Tensor Networks and constraint-based regularization map relations into continuous objectives that can participate in gradient-based optimization Badreddine et al. [2022] , Roychowdhury et al. [2021] , Li et al. [2023] . The symbolic component need not be a discrete theorem prover; it can be a declarative relation whose degree of satisfaction is made differentiable Marra et al. [2024] . In the present framework, this means that the symbolic knowledge is the explicit class-level rule that an embedding should be closer to the prototype of its own class than to competing class prototypes; the degree to which this rule is satisfied is converted into a differentiable loss and optimized jointly with the neural model.
blocks.zh: Neurosymbolic学习将神经表达学习与符号,逻辑,或基于知识的结构Hitzler等人[2022],Wang等人[2025]结合. 不同方法如Logic Tensor Networks和基于约束的规范化关系映射成可参与梯度优化Badreddine et al. [2022],Roychowdhury et al. [2021],Li et al. [2023]. 象征成分不需要是离散定理证明;它可以是宣示性关系,其满足程度可以不同Marra et al. [2024]. 在当前框架中,这意味着象征知识是明确的阶级层次规则,即嵌入式应该更接近本类原型而不是相竞的阶级原型;这一规则的满足程度被转换成不同的损失,并与神经模型共同优化.

blocks.en: Prototype-based learning offers a related geometric mechanism. Prototypical networks, for example, classify a query according to its relation to class prototypes computed in an embedding space Snell et al. [2017] , Zhang et al. [2024] . Prototype learning has also been explored in hyperspectral image classification under limited labeled supervision Ding et al. [2024] , including prototype-rectification strategies designed specifically for cross-domain few-shot classification Qin et al. [2024] . More recent work has further developed global–local prototype representations to construct discriminative spatial–spectral metric spaces for few-shot HSI classification Tang et al. [2025] .
blocks.zh: 基于原型的学习提供了相关的几何机制. 例如,原型网络根据其与嵌入空间Snell等人[2017],Zhang等人[2024]中计算的类原型的关系对查询进行分类. 在有限标签监督下的超光谱图像分类中还探索了原型学习。 [2024],包括专门为跨域几发分类设计的原型校正策略 秦等 [2024]. 最近的工作进一步发展了全球-当地原型说明,为几发HSI分类Tang et al. [2025] 构建歧视性空间-光谱度量空间。

blocks.en: In the present study, prototypes are not used as a meta-learning episode construction. Instead, they ground the explicit relation that an embedding belonging to class c c should be more compatible with prototype c c than with competing class prototypes. The resulting term is used as a training constraint, while prototype-based inference is treated as a separable optional component.
blocks.zh: 在本研究中,原型不用作元学习集构建. 相反,它们认为属于c类的嵌入物应该与c类原型比与竞争的c类原型更兼容。 由此产生的术语被用作训练的制约,而基于原型的推论则被视为可分离的可选成分.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Neurosymbolic Rank-R Framework
blocks.zh: 3 拟议的Neurosymbolic R级框架

blocks.en: This section defines the proposed framework in three parts. Section 3.1 recalls the CP-constrained Rank-R backbone that produces the latent embedding used throughout. Section 3.2 introduces the differentiable prototype-rule regularizer, its class-prototype distance, and its combination with the cross-entropy objective. Section 3.3 then defines the three matched training and inference variants — RankR, RankR - NS - RegOnly, and RankR-NS — used to separate training-time regularization from inference-time prototype fusion. Figure 1 provides a high-level overview of the proposed neurosymbolic Rank-R framework.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 实验方法

blocks.en: This section describes the experimental setup used to answer the research questions in Section 1.1 . Section 4.1 introduces the four hyperspectral datasets and the input construction; Section 4.2 specifies the Rank-R architecture grid and training controls. Section 4.3 defines the spatial leakage-controlled and stratified evaluation protocols, and Section 4.4 details the label-scarcity protocol built on the spatial split. Section 4.5 closes with the Macro-F1-based evaluation and the statistical procedures used to compare methods.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍用于回答第1.1节中研究问题的实验设置. 第4.1节介绍了四个超光谱数据集和输入构造;第4.2节规定了Rank-R架构网格和培训控制。 第4.3节界定了空间渗漏控制和分层评价协议,第4.4节详细说明了基于空间分割的标签-仓储协议。 第4.5节最后介绍了基于宏观-F1的评价和用于比较方法的统计程序。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and input construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和输入构建

blocks.en: Experiments use four established hyperspectral scenes: Pavia University, Indian Pines, Salinas, and Botswana 1 1 1 Grupo de Inteligencia Computacional, University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU), Hyperspectral remote sensing scenes, Public hyperspectral benchmark repository, accessed September 19, 2026. URL: https://www.ehu.eus/ccwintco/index.php?title=Hyperspectral_Remote_Sensing_Scenes . Their standard corrected forms differ substantially in spatial extent, number of classes, and labeled sample count (Table 3 ), providing both urban and vegetation-dominated cases. Each labeled center pixel is represented by a 5 × 5 5\times 5 spatial patch retaining the available spectral channels.Each extracted patch is independently normalized to the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] range using min–max scaling computed over all spatial and spectral entries within that patch.
blocks.zh: 实验使用了四个既定的超光谱场景:帕维亚大学,印度松,萨利纳斯,博茨瓦纳 1 1 1 Grupo de Inteligencia Computacional,巴斯克国家大学(UPV/EHU),超光谱遥感场景,公共超光谱基准库,于2026年9月19日访问. 網址:https://www.ehu.eus/ccwintco/index.php?title=Hyper光谱_Remote_sensing_Scenes. 它们的标准更正表格在空间范围、类别数量和标注的样本数(表3)方面差异很大,提供了城市和植被占主导地位的情况。 每个标注的中间像素都由一个5×5 5\时的5个空间补丁来代表,保留可用的光谱通道. 每个提取的补丁都独立地正常化到[0, 1][0, 1] 范围,使用在该补丁内所有空间和光谱条目上计算出的最小缩放。

blocks.en: The study uses 103 bands for Pavia University, 200 for Indian Pines, 204 for Salinas, and 145 for Botswana, consistent with the commonly used corrected versions in which unusable/noisy bands have already been removed where applicable. The 5 × 5 5\times 5 neighborhood provides local spatial context while remaining compact enough to support the dead-zone-constrained spatial splitting strategy used below; larger neighborhoods would increase the area that must be excluded around split boundaries and would further reduce the number of feasible spatial partitions.

blocks.en: 4.2 Architecture grid and training controls
blocks.zh: 4.2 建筑网格和培训控制

blocks.en: The Rank-R grid is the Cartesian product R ∈ { 3 , 5 } R\in\{3,5\} and hidden dimension H ∈ { 50 , 75 } H\in\{50,75\} , yielding R3-H50, R3-H75, R5-H50, and R5-H75. These configurations are fixed experimental conditions rather than statistical replicates. All standard runs use model seed 1, AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 64, gradient-norm clipping with a maximum norm of 5, and at most 50 training epochs, subject to early stopping.

blocks.en: Model selection uses validation Macro-F1 from the ordinary neural logits, including for the NS-trained model; prototype fusion therefore does not participate in checkpoint selection. Neurosymbolic training activates the rule after 20 warm-up epochs, initializes the prototypes from one non-shuffled pass over the training set, and then jointly optimizes all model parameters. Early stopping uses patience 10 after selection becomes active. The same rule parameters are used throughout: λ rule = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{rule}}=0.1 , margin m = 0.1 m=0.1 , temperature τ = 0.25 \tau=0.25 , and inference-fusion coefficient β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 for RankR-NS (zero for RankR-NS-RegOnly).

blocks.en: The label-scarcity experiment uses a fixed budget of 150 optimization updates with 60 warm-up updates, batch size 64, evaluation batch size 512, learning rate 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and gradient-norm clipping at 5. The same four architectures and the same neurosymbolic hyperparameters are retained. Model seed 1 is fixed so that the intended source of repetition in this experiment is the support-set realization rather than repeated neural initializations.
blocks.zh: 标签-仓储实验采用150个优化更新的固定预算,60个热量更新,批量尺寸64,评价批量尺寸512,学习率2×10−3 2\times 10×3 10×3}重量衰减 10×4 10×4 5 ,梯度规范剪切5 . 同样的四个架构和同样的神经元的超参数被保留下来. 模型种子1是固定的,这样本实验中预期的重复源就是支持-设置实现,而不是重复神经初始化.

blocks.en: 4.3 Spatial and stratified evaluation protocols
blocks.zh: 4.3 空间和分层评价协议

blocks.en:
The primary leakage-aware protocol constructs spatially separated train, validation, and test regions and applies a four-pixel dead-zone/buffer between split roles Gkologkinas et al. [2026] . Because the input is a 5 × 5 5\times 5 patch, this buffer prevents patch footprints from overlapping and, thus, reduces the spatial dependence across splits.
The number of feasible spatial folds is constrained by scene geometry and class coverage: the executed standard evaluation contains three folds for Pavia University and two folds each for Botswana, Indian Pines, and Salinas. Figure 2 demonstrates the proposed area separation.

可行的空间折叠数量受到场景几何和班级覆盖的限制:执行的标准评价包含帕维亚大学的三个折叠,博茨瓦纳,印度松和萨利纳斯各两个折叠. 图2显示了拟议的隔离区。

blocks.en: Botswana required a more permissive validation-block search because of its sparse labeled geometry: the target validation fraction was reduced from 0.10 to 0.06, the minimum validation class-coverage fraction from 0.45 to 0.25, and the minimum validation-patch count from 30 to 10; smaller candidate block scales (0.55 and 0.65) were also admitted. These changes affect split feasibility only and do not alter the Rank-R or neurosymbolic objectives. With so few independent spatial partitions, these runs are summarized descriptively rather than converted into underpowered fold-level significance claims.
blocks.zh: 博茨瓦纳需要更宽松的验证-区块搜索,因为其贴有少量标签的几何:目标验证分数从0.10减少到0.06,最低验证类覆盖分数从0.45减少到0.25,最低验证-区块计数从30减少到10;较小的候选区块尺度(0.55和0.65)也被采纳。 这些变化仅影响分裂的可行性,并不改变Rank-R或神经连锁目标. 由于独立空间分区如此之少,这些跑道被概括为描述性,而不是转换为能力不足的折叠级意义索赔.

blocks.en: A secondary seven-fold stratified protocol is retained for comparability with conventional Rank-R evaluation. Labeled centers are disjoint between train, validation, and test roles, but nearby patches may remain spatially correlated. The standard stratified setup uses 20 training and 10 validation samples per class where feasible; Botswana retains 20 training samples but uses six validation samples per class because of its smaller class supports. Consequently, stratified and spatial results are reported separately and are not pooled as exchangeable replications. The distinction is central to RQ3: the stratified experiment asks how the method behaves under conventional sampling, whereas the spatial experiment provides the more conservative estimate of geographic generalization within a scene Feng et al. [2023] , Cao et al. [2023] .
blocks.zh: 保留了二级七倍分级协议,以便与常规的R级评价进行比较。 标签中心在列车、验证和测试角色之间是脱节的,但附近的补丁可能仍然在空间上相互关联。 标准分级设置在可行的情况下每班使用20个培训和10个验证样本;博茨瓦纳保留20个训练样本,但由于班级支持较小,每班使用6个验证样本。 因此,分层和空间结果单独报告,不作为可交换的复制品汇总。 区别是RQ3的核心:分层实验询问该方法在常规采样下的表现方式,而空间实验则提供了一个场景冯等人[2023],曹等人[2023]的地域概括性更保守的估计.

blocks.en: 4.4 Label-scarcity protocol
blocks.zh: 4.4 标签仓储协议

blocks.en: Because the support-set size increases with K K while the optimization budget remains fixed at 150 updates, the effective number of passes through the support set is larger at small K K and smaller at large K K . The scarcity experiment therefore controls update budget rather than epoch budget.

(12) For each spatial fold, five support seeds (101, 202, 303, 404, and 505) generate nested support sets, so that a larger K K extends rather than replaces the support ordering associated with that seed. This pairing is essential because changes with K K are then less contaminated by unrelated resampling. The experiment contains 3,360 method-level evaluations (2,240 trained models, since RankR-NS and RankR-NS-RegOnly share a checkpoint) across datasets, spatial folds, support seeds, budgets, architectures, and the three method variants.

blocks.en: The usable scarcity-fold counts are three for Pavia University, two for Botswana, two for Salinas, and one for Indian Pines. K = 1 K=1 is intentionally excluded from the main study because a one-sample class prototype is identical to its sole support embedding and therefore ceases to represent an aggregate class-level relation.
blocks.zh: 可用稀缺倍数为帕维亚大学的3个、博茨瓦纳的2个、萨利纳斯的2个和印度松。 K = 1 K = 1 被故意排除在主研究之外,因为一个单样类原型与其唯一支持嵌入完全相同,因此不再代表一个总类关系.

blocks.en: 4.5 Evaluation and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 评价和统计分析

blocks.en:
Macro-F1 is the primary response because the datasets are class imbalanced and the neurosymbolic rule is defined at class level. For each evaluation fold, Macro-F1 is calculated as
the unweighted mean of the class-specific F1 scores, considering only classes with non-zero ground-truth support in that fold. Overall accuracy is retained as a secondary descriptive metric in the archived results but is not used to drive the paper’s inferential claims. All method comparisons are paired within the same split and architecture.

blocks.en: The results are organized to test whether the prototype-rule effect is stable across the conditions introduced in Section 4 , or whether it depends on how and where it is measured. Section 5.1 reports dataset-level changes under the spatial and stratified protocols, which already show considerable heterogeneity; Section 5.2 shows that this heterogeneity persists, and in places reverses, at the level of individual architectures. Section 5.3 turns to the label-scarcity study, asking whether the effect strengthens as supervision decreases.

RankR-NS-RegOnly is also positive on average at all budgets, with smaller gains of +0.24–+0.62 pp. Taking the difference between the two rows of Table 6 , the average incremental contribution of fusion is modest, ranging from − 0.03 -0.03 pp at K = 7 K=7 to + 0.35 +0.35 pp at K = 5 K=5 . blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this section we discuss the results in relation to the five research questions. Section 6.1 addresses RQ1 and RQ3, arguing that the neurosymbolic effect is conditional rather than universal and depends on the evaluation protocol. Section 6.2 addresses RQ2, attributing most of the effect to training-time regularization rather than inference-time fusion, while Section 6.3 addresses RQ4 and RQ5, showing that the effect of label scarcity is not monotonic and interacts with dataset and architecture. Section 6.4 clarifies the intended, restricted sense in which the mechanism is called neurosymbolic, and Section 6.5 states the study’s limitations.
blocks.zh: 本节讨论五个研究问题的结果。 第6.1节涉及RQ1和RQ3,认为神经连锁效应是有条件的而不是普遍的,取决于评价协议. 第6.2节涉及RQ2,将大部分影响归结为培训时间正规化而非推论时间聚变,第6.3节涉及RQ4和RQ5,表明标签稀缺的影响不是单调的,并与数据集和架构相互作用. 第6.4节澄清了所谓神经系统机制的预期和限制意义,第6.5节说明了研究的局限性。

blocks.en: 6.1 A conditional rather than universal neurosymbolic effect
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 有条件而非普遍的神经连锁效应

blocks.en: The experiments answer RQ1 with a qualified result. Prototype-rule regularization can materially improve a Rank-R model, but the sign and magnitude of the effect depend on the dataset and architecture. This is most visible in the spatial evaluation, where the end-to-end RankR-NS effect ranges from +8.82 pp on Botswana to -0.62 pp on Salinas. The result is therefore stronger than a claim of negligible average change but weaker than a claim of universal benefit. Such heterogeneity is also visible in the stratified protocol, where Salinas is the only dataset for which full NS is consistently below RankR in all seven folds and the post-hoc comparison survives Holm correction.
blocks.zh: 实验以合格结果回答RQ1. 原型规则规范化可以实质上改进Rank-R模型,但效果的标志和规模取决于数据集和架构. 这在空间评价中最为明显,其端到端的RankR-NS效应从博茨瓦纳的+8.82页到萨利纳斯的-0.62页不等. 因此,结果胜过声称平均变化微不足道,但弱于声称普遍受益。 这种异质性也可见于分层协议中,其中萨利纳斯是唯一一个完全NS在所有七个折叠中始终低于RankR的数据集,并且模拟后比较存活下来. 霍尔姆修正。

blocks.en: The fact that protocol changes can alter the magnitude and, for some contrasts, the apparent direction is also important for RQ3. Stratified folds provide more replications and support non-parametric testing, but they do not reproduce the geographic independence of the spatial folds. The spatial experiment should therefore be treated as the primary evidence about leakage-controlled within-scene generalization, while the stratified experiment serves as a conventional comparison. A method whose advantage is visible only under one sampling scheme would warrant caution; here, the broad dataset pattern (strong Botswana, positive Indian/Pavia in several settings, weak or negative Salinas) persists sufficiently to indicate genuine dataset dependence rather than a single protocol artifact.
blocks.zh: 协议的改变可以改变规模,对某些对比而言,明显的方向对于RQ3也很重要. 分层折叠提供了更多的复制,并支持非参数测试,但它们并不复制空间折叠的地理独立性. 因此,空间实验应作为控制渗漏的场内普遍化的主要证据,而分层实验则作为常规比较。 一种只在一种抽样办法下才具有明显优势的方法值得谨慎;在这方面,广泛的数据集模式(博茨瓦纳强势、印度/帕维亚在若干环境中呈正值、萨利纳斯弱弱或负值)继续存在,足以表明真正的数据集依赖性,而不是单一的协议文物。

blocks.en: 6.2 Training-time regularization is the main mechanism
blocks.zh: 6.2 培训时间正规化是主要机制

blocks.en: RQ2 is addressed by the shared-checkpoint ablation. Across the spatial datasets, RankR-NS-RegOnly already accounts for most of the difference from RankR. Full inference fusion adds less than one percentage point in absolute Macro-F1 on every dataset and is negative on Pavia University and Salinas. Under stratified evaluation, fusion is negative in all seven Pavia folds and significantly reduces the regularization-only result after Holm correction. In the label-scarcity study, the equal-weighted difference between RankR-NS and RankR-NS-RegOnly is likewise small relative to the full contrast with RankR.
blocks.zh: RQ2通过共享检查点减值处理. 在整个空间数据集中,RankR-NS-RegOnly已经占了与RankR的大部分区别. 完全推论核聚变在每个数据集的绝对Macro-F1中增加不到一个百分点,对帕维亚大学和萨利纳斯则呈负数. 在分层评价下,聚变在所有七个帕维亚折叠中都是负的,并显著降低了霍尔姆修正后仅规范化的结果. 在标签-scarity研究中,RankR-NS和RankR-NS-RegOnly的等重差与RankR的完全对比同样小.

blocks.en: This pattern suggests that the primary value of the prototype rule is not a second classifier layered on top of the network. Instead, it acts mainly as a training constraint on the geometry of the latent representation. This interpretation is consistent with the intended complementarity of the two inductive biases: the Rank-R decomposition restricts the tensor mapping, while the prototype rule constrains class organization in the embedding space. The inference fusion can still help in particular regimes, but the results do not justify treating it as uniformly beneficial.
blocks.zh: 这种模式表明,原型规则的主要价值不是网络上层的第二个分类器. 相反,它主要是对潜在代表几何的训练限制。 这种解释符合两种诱导偏差的预期互补性:Rank-R分解限制了拉伸映射,而原型规则则限制了嵌入空间中的阶级组织. 推论结合仍然可以帮助特定制度,但结果不能证明有理由将推论视为一致有益。

blocks.en: 6.3 Label scarcity does not produce a simple monotonic response
blocks.zh: 6.3 标签缺乏不会产生简单的单调反应

blocks.en: RQ4 yields a more nuanced result than the initial hypothesis that symbolic structure should become increasingly valuable as supervision decreases. The cross-dataset gain is positive at every tested K K , and 22 of 32 fold-level slopes point toward a larger advantage at lower budgets. Nevertheless, the aggregate curve is non-monotonic and none of the architecture-specific slope tests survives Holm correction. The strongest directional pattern occurs for R5-H75 (seven of eight negative slopes), but even there the corrected evidence is insufficient for a general claim.
blocks.zh: 与最初的假设相比,RQ4产生更细微的结果,即随着监督的减少,象征性结构应变得日益重要。 跨数据集增益在每一次测试的K K 中都是正数,32个折叠级斜率中的22个指向更低预算的更大优势. 尽管如此,总曲线是非模态的,建筑特有的坡度测试都没有存活下来. 霍尔姆修正。 R5-H75(8个负斜坡中的7个)发生最强的方向模式,但即使在那里,经更正的证据也不足以提出一般索赔。

blocks.en: The more defensible interpretation is therefore that scarcity can expose useful prototype regularization in some configurations, but it does not act as a single control variable that determines the effect. Dataset geometry, class compactness, architecture, and the quality of prototypes estimated from very small supports all plausibly interact with K K . Salinas is instructive: reducing the label budget does not reliably turn a negative standard-evaluation effect into a positive one. Conversely, Botswana remains favorable across essentially the entire scarcity range. These observations make RQ5 at least as important as RQ4.
blocks.zh: 因此,更合理的解释是,稀缺可能暴露出一些配置中有用的原型正规化,但它并没有起到决定效果的单一控制变量的作用. 数据集几何学,类紧凑性,架构,以及从非常小的支撑力中估计出来的原型的质量,都与K K K 进行合理互动. 萨利纳斯很有启发性:降低标签预算并不能可靠地将负面的标准评价效应转化为积极的影响. 反过来说,博茨瓦纳仍然基本上在整个稀缺范围内都处于有利地位。 这些观察使RQ5至少与RQ4一样重要.

blocks.en: 6.4 Why call the mechanism neurosymbolic?
blocks.zh: 6.4 (中文(简体) ). 为什么把机制叫做神经元?

blocks.en: The prototype itself is a learned numerical parameter and is not symbolic merely because it is initialized from an average embedding. The neurosymbolic element is the explicit relation imposed on those grounded class symbols: an embedding labeled as class c c should satisfy a compatibility relation with the prototype representing c c and should be separated from prototypes representing alternative classes. That relation is named, inspectable, and added to the neural objective as a differentiable constraint. The relation is only as meaningful as the grounding of the symbols it refers to Marconato et al. [2023] . Here, that grounding is minimal, since each class symbol is anchored solely to the mean of the labelled embeddings of that class and is thereafter free to drift with the representation. Because the anchoring comes from class labels rather than from unsupervised concept discovery, the rule can be satisfied only through class-consistent geometry. This is a deliberately modest use of the term neurosymbolic: the framework does not claim discrete reasoning or external domain knowledge, but it does separate a declarative class relation from the unconstrained neural classification objective.
blocks.zh: 原型本身是一个学到的数值参数,并不仅仅是因为它是从平均嵌入初始化的. 神经元是对这些被禁用的类符号施加的明确关系:被标记为c类c的嵌入物应满足与代表c的原型的兼容关系,并应与代表替代类的原型分离. 这种关系被命名为,可检查,并添加到神经目标上,作为不同的制约. 关系的意义只如它所提到的马可纳托等人[2023]的符号的定位. 在这里,这种定位是最低限度的,因为每一类符号都完全固定在该类标记嵌入的平均值上,然后可以随代表物漂移。 由于锚定来源于类标签而非无监督的概念发现,该规则只能通过类一致几何来满足. 这是故意适度使用神经元的术语:框架不主张离散推理或外部域知识,但确实将声明类关系与不受约束的神经分类目标区分开来.

blocks.en: 6.5 Limitations and implications
blocks.zh: 6.5 限制和影响

blocks.en:
Several limitations bound the conclusions. First, the standard experiments primarily use one model seed, so the independent spatial partitions provide stronger evidence about sampling variation than about variation due to neural initialization. Second, only two or three spatial folds are feasible for most datasets, and the scarcity study has only one independent Indian Pines spatial fold; support seeds improve characterization of support selection but are not substitutes for independent spatial replications. Third, a single prototype per class favors compact class geometry and may be inappropriate for multimodal classes.
Recent few-shot HSI work has similarly questioned prototypes derived solely from a small number of support samples and explored trainable semantic anchors to enrich prototype representations Yan et al. [2026] .
Fourth, the neurosymbolic hyperparameters are held fixed across datasets rather than tuned separately, which is useful for controlled comparison but may understate achievable performance in some scenes. Fifth, the knowledge grounding is induced from labeled embeddings rather than supplied by an external ontology or expert knowledge base. Finally, the study covers four hyperspectral datasets and four Rank-R architectures; it characterizes this mechanism rather than neurosymbolic learning in general.
blocks.zh:
这些结论受若干限制的约束。 首先,标准实验主要使用一个模型种子,因此独立的空间分区提供了比神经初始化导致的变异更强的采样变异证据. 其次,对于大多数数据集来说,只有两三个空间折叠是可行的,而稀缺性研究只有一个独立的印第安松空间折叠;支持种子改善了支持选择的特征,但并不是独立的空间复制的替代品. 第三,每个类的单一原型偏好紧凑的类几何,可能不适合多式联运类.
最近几弹的HSI工作同样质疑完全来自少数支持样本的原型,并探索了可训练的语义锚,以丰富原型表述 颜等 [2026].
第四,神经同位素超参数被固定在数据集之间,而不是单独调制,这对控制比较有用,但可能低估某些场景中可实现的性能. 第五,知识的落地来源于标签嵌入物,而不是由外部肿瘤学或专家知识库提供。 最后,该研究涵盖四个超光谱数据集和四个Rank-R架构;其特征是这种机制,而不是一般的神经连锁学习.

blocks.en: The failed mixed-effects diagnostics also motivate a methodological point. Repeated support-set realizations create a rich empirical surface, but treating them as if they supplied many independent spatial units can produce unstable hierarchical fits. The fold-level sensitivity analysis used here is more conservative: it sacrifices nominal sample size in exchange for an inferential unit that better matches the spatial generalization question.
blocks.zh: 失败的混合效应诊断也激发了一个方法点. 重复的支持设置实现创造了丰富的实证表面,但把它们当作提供了许多独立的空间单位来对待,可以产生不稳定的等级匹配. 这里使用的折叠级敏感度分析较为保守:它牺牲标称样本大小,以换取更符合空间泛化问题的推论单位.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This work evaluates a simple differentiable prototype rule as a second inductive bias for Rank-R tensor neural networks. The evidence does not support a universal neurosymbolic advantage. Under spatial leakage control, full NS improves architecture-averaged Macro-F1 on Botswana (+8.82 pp), Indian Pines (+5.49 pp), and Pavia University (+1.59 pp), but decreases it on Salinas (-0.62 pp). The regularization-only ablation preserves most of the positive effect, whereas prototype fusion contributes only small, dataset-dependent changes and can be harmful. Stratified evaluation confirms the heterogeneity and yields corrected evidence of a full-NS degradation on Salinas and a fusion penalty on Pavia University.
blocks.zh: 这部作品评价了一个简单的不同原型规则,作为Rank-R lomor神经网络的第二个诱导偏差. 证据并不支持普遍的神经连锁优势. 在空间渗漏控制下,全NS改进了博茨瓦纳(+8.82页),印度松(+5.49页)和帕维亚大学(+1.59页)的建筑-平均Macro-F1,但在萨利纳斯(-0.62页)上却减少了. 仅规范化的退缩保留了大部分的正面效果,而原型核聚变只有助于小的,依赖数据集的变化,并且可能有害. 分级评估证实了异质性,并得出了萨利纳斯完全NS降解和帕维亚大学聚变处罚的校正证据.

blocks.en: The dedicated label-scarcity study further shows that the NS gain is positive on average across all tested budgets but is not monotonic in the number of labels. Although 22 of 32 fold-level slopes are directionally consistent with a larger advantage at lower K K , none of the architecture-wise slope tests remains significant after Holm correction. The principal conclusion is therefore mechanistic rather than competitive: prototype-rule regularization can complement the structural bias of Rank-R learning, primarily by shaping the learned representation, but its utility is conditioned by dataset, architecture, and evaluation regime. Future work should test multi-prototype or structured expert-grounded rules and evaluate them with more independent spatial repetitions and neural seeds.
blocks.zh: 专门的标签-恐惧研究进一步表明,在经过测试的所有预算中,NS的增益平均是积极的,但在标签数量上并不是单调的。 虽然32个折叠级坡度中的22个在方向上与KK下游的较大优势一致,但是在霍尔姆修正后,任何建筑型坡度测试都没有保持显著. 因此,主要结论是机械性而非竞争性的:原型规则正规化可以补充R级学习的结构偏差,主要是通过塑造学到的代表性,但其效用取决于数据集、结构和评价制度。 今后的工作应测试多原型或结构化的专家基础规则,并以更独立的空间重复和神经种子来评价这些规则。
